description: 直接查询 SLS model-access。仅展示请求元数据与质量指标，不展示 prompt/response 内容。

panels.description: 按时间倒序显示最近请求。厂商筛选值是 upstream_cluster 搜索表达式，默认 *。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, response_flags, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms, CASE WHEN "ai_log.output_token" > 1 AND "ai_log.llm_service_duration" >= "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" THEN round(("ai_log.llm_service_duration" - "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration") / ("ai_log.output_token" - 1), 2) ELSE NULL END AS tpot_ms, "ai_log.input_token" AS input_tokens, "ai_log.output_token" AS output_tokens, "ai_log.cached_tokens" AS cached_tokens WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 最近请求明细

panels.description: 按单请求 TTFT 从高到低排序，用于定位首 token 长尾。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: TTFT 最慢请求 Top 100

panels.description: TPOT=(完整服务时长-TTFT)/(输出 token-1)，输出 token 少于 2 时不计算。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, round(("ai_log.llm_service_duration" - "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration") / ("ai_log.output_token" - 1), 2) AS tpot_ms, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms, "ai_log.output_token" AS output_tokens WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND "ai_log.output_token" > 1 AND "ai_log.llm_service_duration" >= "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" ORDER BY tpot_ms DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: TPOT 最慢请求 Top 100

panels.description: 网关最终返回 5xx 的请求，按时间倒序。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, response_flags, "ai_log.response_error" AS response_error WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND response_code >= 500 ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 5xx 请求明细

panels.description: 所有厂商 429 请求证据，用于观察授信、余额、并发保护或厂商侧限流。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, "ai_log.rate_limit_evaluation" AS rate_limit_evaluation WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND response_code = 429 ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 100
